acceptance_criteria.text: Research, Plan, Implement, Validate and Spike route final outcomes, questions, comments, artifact references and applicable workflow contributions through shared semantic validation and receipts. Production paths cover MCP enabled and disabled, helper and applicable structured terminal adapters, with factory-bound identities and an explicit compatibility or upgrade/admission route for every supported unmanaged/legacy launch.

Preflight, submission and post-exit processing reuse shared result/workflow validators and independently project input, engineering, acceptance and remote-effect states. Existing Plan publication/freezing and StoryProgress/acceptance authority remain with their current owners; an MCP comment or input receipt alone cannot publish stories or establish workflow success.

Validate can return its complete reference-only structured terminal assessment against frozen scope and retained checks, reconcile duplicate or conflicting live/terminal contributions without partial acceptance or redundant required submission, and retain its read-only profile without shell, edits, new checks, capture or delegation.

After nominal process success, absent or malformed required output records actionable incomplete/invalid finalization and prevents workflow success. Failure, cancellation and interruption preserve the original cause, valid checkpoints and resumable intent; valid input cannot turn them into success, and post-exit rejection remains available on the next authorized attempt. The factory must not fabricate an automatic post-exit correction or acceptance.

Retained production-constructor and runner tests cover all five modes, MCP on/off, cold/resumed/fallback bindings, supported compatibility routes, missing/malformed/conflicting output and all termination outcomes. The completion seam invokes authoritative evidence validation; full persisted aggregate enrichment is completed in US-002 before the adoption milestone.

acceptance_criteria.text: Cold attempts receive an explicit empty baseline; continued, restarted and fallback attempts receive sufficient authorized editable prior state with stable IDs and observed base revisions in launch context or scoped service reads. Prior prose/provider session reuse is never the baseline.

Historical result and receipt reads expose only explicitly granted scope; unrelated results/receipts remain inaccessible and retired IDs remain retired. Replaced attempts cannot regain mutation authority through historical reads.

Sparse updates validate the full merged result including untouched fields/evidence references. Stale revisions, malformed fields and invalid references reject atomically with field-specific diagnostics and an authorized current revision/read route for correction.

Stable request identity recovers the same durable result/receipt after reply loss and restart, without duplicate workflow changes or external effects; corrected submissions follow a new request identity.

Implement completion resolves aggregate/checkpoint and prior completion evidence from authoritative retained records through the existing validator in preflight, submit and final enforcement. Missing/stale/misattributed evidence or a mismatched current worktree cannot pass claimed engineering completion.

acceptance_criteria.text: A separate evidence-backed disposition for Plan v1 file handoff, Implement event-file ingress and Validate v1 assessment parsing records consumers, supported versions/cohorts, pending effects and each required upgrade/completion/drain prerequisite. Read-only runtime evidence identifies the inspected cohort and time; fixtures alone cannot establish live drain.

For each affected cohort, required completion or migration occurs only through supported admission/upgrade flows with any required operator authorization and retained receipts. Content/submission upgrades preserve persisted workflow versions; no manual daemon-state/version rewriting is used.
Once its supported consumer/cohort and pending-effect prerequisites are evidenced, Plan v1 file ingress and exclusive wiring are removed while v2 internal Plan handoffs/publication remain usable.

Once its supported consumer/cohort and pending-effect prerequisites are evidenced, Implement event-file ingress and exclusive wiring are removed while StoryProgress records, recovery and delivery remain usable.

Once its supported consumer/cohort and pending-effect prerequisites are evidenced, Validate v1 parser ingress and exclusive wiring are removed while its restricted structured terminal assessment remains usable.

Old-database migration, historical-read, restart/recovery and remaining workflow-v1 regression checks pass. Missing access, unresolved supported work or undrained effects keep the affected removal criteria and retirement milestone incomplete; retain required readers and prepare a focused follow-up title/body/source links and explicit scope revision for owner decision, without treating that proposal as removal or automatic waiver.

acceptance_criteria.text: Retained executed production-composition and local persistence/recovery checks cover all five modes and the approved cold/continuation/sparse/retry/stale/malformed/missing-output/failure/cancellation/interruption matrix, including evidence-backed completion, restricted terminal assessment, authorized publication recovery and advisory progress. Evidence identifies check IDs, implementation revision and environment.

Aggregate source comparison confirms both installed instruction trees match the canonical adopted contract after their independent stories complete, preserving role restrictions, mode-header authority and immutable releases.

An aggregate disposition audit matches all four old inputs to the actual removal diff, preserved shared helpers and applicable compatibility evidence. Adoption and retirement statuses are recorded separately; any unmet US-009 removal criterion prevents all-feature completion unless an explicit approved scope revision changes it.

make check passes using the pinned repository lint/test workflow and gofmt -l . reports no files; passing output and the corresponding implementation state are retained. No dist build, invented integration tag/name or live paid/nested provider invocation is used.

The final evidence inventory distinguishes source/synthetic assertions from authentic host observations. The four authentic working/Validate capture obligations remain on #274/#296 and unsatisfied until externally supplied with provenance/version bounds; offline tests do not establish actual tool invocation, same-run correction, observed authoritative receipt or present-day host restrictions.
